STEP3.TM_NONE_EXPLAIN: No filing carries this name in the official INPI (France) and EUIPO (Europe) databases — neither identically, nor once spaces, hyphens and accents are set aside. Good sign, but it does not cover similar marks (close to the ear or the eye), which only a trademark attorney can assess. Next step: secure the name by filing your trademark before you go public.
STEP3.TM_EXACT_EXPLAIN: An identical trademark is already registered. Using this name in the same classes of goods/services exposes you to an opposition or an infringement action. Check the classes below: if they don't overlap your activity, use may still be possible — have it validated by an IP attorney.
STEP3.TM_SIMILAR_EXPLAIN: Similar trademarks exist. The risk depends on the degree of similarity and class overlap. Before any filing, a thorough prior-art search and the advice of an IP attorney are recommended.
STEP3.TM_UNKNOWN_EXPLAIN: The automatic check could not complete for this name (source unavailable). Run the official INPI search to decide.

HOME.WHO_TEXT: Whether you are launching a startup, an online shop, a restaurant, a mobile app, a consulting firm or a cosmetics brand, Namorama helps you find a memorable name whose domain is still free. Ideal for naming a startup, a new product, or rebranding an existing business.
HOME.FAQ_Q1: How do I find an available domain name?
HOME.FAQ_A1: Describe your project on Namorama: the AI proposes product, brand or company names, and automatically checks their domain availability against the registries. Free names show up instantly, ready to register with your registrar.
HOME.FAQ_Q2: Can I try it for free?
HOME.FAQ_A2: Yes: you get 100 credits every month, no subscription. One domain suggestion costs 1 credit. An in-depth report costs 50 credits per name. Commitment-free packs are available afterwards.
HOME.FAQ_A3: Yes. Unlike generators that merely estimate, Namorama queries the registry in real time (RDAP, with WHOIS as fallback). A domain shown as available really is at the time of the search, and an unreachable registry is flagged as such rather than guessed.
HOME.FAQ_A4: The most common ones such as .com, .fr, .io, .co or .net, plus any others you add for your project. Results are shown as a comparison table.
HOME.GUIDES_LEAD: The pages Google indexes, and through which your future customers arrive.
HOME.GUIDES_NOTE_EN: These guides are currently available in French.
HOME.FINAL_H2: Got a name in mind? Check right now whether it's free
HOME.FINAL_TEXT: 100 credits every month: about 50 checked suggestions, or 30 suggestions and one in-depth report.
HOME.CONTROLS_NOTE: Built for the French market: names that work in French, European extensions first, data hosted in the European Union.
